name: Jean-Pierre Tremblay
bio:
Jean-Pierre's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood summers spent at the Circuit Gilles Villeneuve, captivated by the roar of the engines. He pursued a degree in Mechanical Engineering, focusing on vehicle dynamics and aerodynamics. After graduating, Jean-Pierre began his career as a data analyst for a smaller racing team, quickly proving his aptitude for translating complex data into actionable insights. 

His approach to the Sporting Director role is rooted in meticulous planning and a data-driven mindset. He believes in empowering his team, fostering a collaborative environment where innovation thrives. Jean-Pierre distinguishes himself through his unwavering calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to identify unconventional solutions to complex challenges, always striving to push the boundaries of performance.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part.
physical.description: Jean-Pierre is of average height with a lean build, often seen wearing glasses.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with calculations and diagrams.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Insists on using metric measurements for everything, even in informal settings.
